deceased.name: Izuchukwu Chisom Okeke
deceased.biography: Izuchukwu Chisom Okeke, lovingly known as Soft Lion, will be remembered with love by his family, friends and everyone whose life he touched.
deceased.quote: Some lives leave footprints that time cannot erase.

approvedMessages.message: Soft Lion will be remembered for his warmth, kindness and the joy he brought to everyone around him. May his memory remain a blessing.
My deepest condolences to the family. Wishing you comfort, strength and peace as you honour a life so deeply loved.
May the beautiful memories you shared bring comfort in the days ahead. You are all in my thoughts and prayers.
May God grant the family strength and surround you with peace during this difficult season.
Your kindness and gentle spirit will not be forgotten. Rest peacefully, Soft Lion.
Thinking of the family with love and prayer. May every precious memory bring comfort.
